items.title: IA26 Schedule
items.why: Iceland Airwaves is a one of a kind music festival. Amazing musicians in the coolest venues all around Reykjavík.

items.title: Daði Freyr og Sinfó
items.why: Daði Freyr is iconic, he is the moment, he is Iceland's unofficial Eurovision winner. He's known for quirky techno music with cathcy melodies, so collaborating with the Icelandic Symphony makes perfect sense. Seeing this would be the coolest flex and it's going to be a night to remember!

items.title: Púðursykur
items.why: We've been to a couple of these standup shows and it is always very entertaining. All the comedians are amazing and it's in a cozy venue. It's giving New York comedy cellar.

items.title: The Streets with Úlfur Úlfur
items.why: This is without a doubt one of the most exciting events this week!
